note: Plan for the free activity pages. One entry = one topic = 3 pages (English, Spanish, Portuguese). The writer robot (scripts/pages_write.py) writes the entries that are not in data/pages.json yet, in this order, and adds new entries by itself when a new episode appears. Each slug is a real search phrase; it must not repeat an episode page's phrase.

topics.idea: A 15-minute game to learn 5 to 6 simple Christmas words in English from the episode (for example tree, star, bell, gift, sock), by showing real things or drawings and playing 'what is missing?'.

phrases.es: palabras de Navidad en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: palavras de Natal em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: A dress-up game to learn winter clothes in English (hat, scarf, gloves, coat, boots) using real clothes from home or class.

phrases.es: ropa de invierno en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: roupas de inverno em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: A guessing game with the zoo animals from the episode: the adult makes an animal sound or shows a picture, children say the animal name in English.

phrases.es: juego de animales en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: jogo dos animais em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: Plant a bean seed in a cup with the children and learn the words seed, soil, water, sun, plant; then watch it grow over the next days.

phrases.en: plant a seed activity for preschool
phrases.es: actividad de plantar semillas para niños
phrases.pt: atividade de plantar sementes para crianças

topics.idea: A counting walk around the room, the house or the garden: find 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 things and count them out loud in English.

phrases.es: contar hasta 5 en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: contar até 5 em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: Sort toys, blocks or paper pieces into color groups (cups, bowls or paper circles) and name each color in English. Different from the color hunt: children sort, not search.

phrases.es: clasificar colores en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: separar cores em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: Numbers 1 to 5 written on paper sheets on the floor; children hop to the number the adult says and clap that many times. Gross-motor counting game.

phrases.es: juego de números en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: jogo dos números em inglês para crianças

topics.idea: Move like the zoo animals that are in the episode (only animals the episode page names) and say the animal names and simple action words in English (walk, stomp, jump, swing). Different from the sounds game: this one is about moving.

phrases.en: move like animals game for toddlers
phrases.es: moverse como animales en inglés para niños
phrases.pt: mover como os animais em inglês para crianças
